title: Power Rankings: Suns take over top spot from Mavs thanks to streak
heading: 2006-07 Power Rankings: Week 13
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: We'd make a bigger deal about Suns' alleged struggles vs. Jazz, Spurs and Lakers if their four losses to those teams hadn't come so early, all before Thanksgiving.
rankings.summaryText: We'd make a bigger deal about Suns' alleged struggles vs. Jazz, Spurs and Lakers if their four losses to those teams hadn't come so early, all before Thanksgiving.

rankings.summaryHtml: It's a rough world out there: Mavs have played .917 ball since Dec. 13, winning 22 of 24 in that span, yet can't really hit us with a protest that they've slipped to No. 2.
rankings.summaryText: It's a rough world out there: Mavs have played .917 ball since Dec. 13, winning 22 of 24 in that span, yet can't really hit us with a protest that they've slipped to No. 2.

rankings.summaryHtml: Sympathy for Spurs is in short supply, even though they're a mere 8-6 in January. Reason being: Spurs are on a 57-25 pace and still have the NBA's third-best record.
rankings.summaryText: Sympathy for Spurs is in short supply, even though they're a mere 8-6 in January. Reason being: Spurs are on a 57-25 pace and still have the NBA's third-best record.

rankings.summaryHtml: No one expected these guys to lead the East at any stage, but credit where credit is due: Wiz are 22-8 since their 4-9 start and 9-5 since starting 0-8 on the road.
rankings.summaryText: No one expected these guys to lead the East at any stage, but credit where credit is due: Wiz are 22-8 since their 4-9 start and 9-5 since starting 0-8 on the road.

rankings.summaryHtml: Texas has a truly fearsome triangle going when Houston, which was 16-11 with Yao, can maintain its push for a top-four seed by going 11-5 without him.
rankings.summaryText: Texas has a truly fearsome triangle going when Houston, which was 16-11 with Yao, can maintain its push for a top-four seed by going 11-5 without him.

rankings.summaryHtml: It's been a painful January by any measure: Jazz are just 7-7 this month after losses to Grizz and Hornets and now Boozer and Kirilenko are carrying injuries.
rankings.summaryText: It's been a painful January by any measure: Jazz are just 7-7 this month after losses to Grizz and Hornets and now Boozer and Kirilenko are carrying injuries.

rankings.summaryHtml: After a 1-5 start to the New Year, Bulls are back in the top 10 (where they belong) with a 6-2 spurt that includes impressive home victories over Spurs and Mavs.
rankings.summaryText: After a 1-5 start to the New Year, Bulls are back in the top 10 (where they belong) with a 6-2 spurt that includes impressive home victories over Spurs and Mavs.

rankings.summaryHtml: Pistons apparently still play DEE-TROIT BAS-KET-BALL on occasion. They're 15-1 when holding teams below 90 ppg and have the East's only winning road record at 13-8.
rankings.summaryText: Pistons apparently still play DEE-TROIT BAS-KET-BALL on occasion. They're 15-1 when holding teams below 90 ppg and have the East's only winning road record at 13-8.

rankings.summaryHtml: Going 12-9 without Odom -- with 13 of those games on the road -- was impressive. Getting swept by Bobcats and losing twice to banged-up Hornets, not so much.
rankings.summaryText: Going 12-9 without Odom -- with 13 of those games on the road -- was impressive. Getting swept by Bobcats and losing twice to banged-up Hornets, not so much.

rankings.summaryHtml: Pacers might be an afterthought around town because of a little game Colts have next week, but they looked pretty good at home in sweeping Bulls, Heat and Raps.

rankings.summaryHtml: Ouch. Just starting out on a stretch with nine of 11 games at home, Cavs have dropped the first three at the Q and watched LeBron pick up a toe injury.

rankings.summaryHtml: The committee was treated to a heartwarming surprise, receiving numerous e-mails calling for one of our famous Pape Sow comments even with Raps in first place.

rankings.summaryHtml: Melo will have played only five games in his comeback by the time West coaches turn in their All-Star reserve picks Tuesday. Not much time to impress, in other words.

rankings.summaryHtml: With the help of a 4-1 homestand, Clips claw back to .500. But they've got just six road wins in 20 tries, with a seven-game trip through the East starting Friday.
rankings.summaryText: With the help of a 4-1 homestand, Clips claw back to .500. But they've got just six road wins in 20 tries, with a seven-game trip through the East starting Friday.

rankings.summaryHtml: I'll say this about Wolves: With KG out there, they almost always play hard. Which might be enough to hold off up-and-down Clips and young, ailing Warriors for No. 8.

rankings.summaryHtml: Trivia time: Nets are just the fourth team in history to suffer three consecutive losses by a single point, joining Pacers (1999), Lakers (1995) and Bulls (1987).

rankings.summaryHtml: With the second-fewest road victories in the league at 4-15, Golden State's playoff hopes might hinge on the six-game East trip that starts Tuesday in Cleveland.

rankings.summaryHtml: Shaq's return hasn't exactly inspired the champs, who are 0-3 since, but Heat haters should note that Miami arguably has the East's easiest remaining schedule.

rankings.summaryHtml: Ariza wasn't exactly a go-to guy for young Magic, but facts is facts: Orlando's current 1-7 nosedive to No. 7 in the East started as soon as Ariza got injured.

rankings.summaryHtml: Kudos to the never-gets-his-due Byron Scott: Hornets, still waiting for Chris Paul's return, have countered a 4-19 slide and all those injuries by going 6-3 since Jan. 8.

rankings.summaryHtml: Randolph isn't surrendering his All-Star dream that easy, racking up some big numbers in a 5-3 spurt that already has Blazers just two W's shy of last season's 21.

rankings.summaryHtml: You laughed when we called this Matt Carroll's team, but Bobcats are 8-7 -- and 2-0 vs. Lakers -- since Carroll's first 20-point game Dec. 29 against L.A.

rankings.summaryHtml: The good news: Redd is due back about a week before the All-Star break. The bad news: Banged-up Bucks are 2-9 without him and just 2-11 in 2007.

rankings.summaryHtml: Don't say we didn't warn you: Miller-led Sixers have just won three of four and have only 12 road games left after January, none of which helps their Oden-Durant odds.

rankings.summaryHtml: Hawks were 6-7 in November and are 6-7 in January. Just don't ask about that 3-13 December that dropped them down into their usual spot among the stragglers.
